// categorizeFile returns the chip category for a file's category color.
// Order matters — first match wins.
func categorizeFile(p, language string) string {
	lower := strings.ToLower(p)

	hasDirSegment := func(seg string) bool {
		// Match `seg/...`, `.../seg/...`. We don't match suffix-only because
		// "test" in a filename shouldn't count as a directory segment.
		return strings.HasPrefix(lower, seg+"/") || strings.Contains(lower, "/"+seg+"/")
	}

	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, "_test.go") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".test.ts") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, "_test.py") ||
		hasDirSegment("test") ||
		hasDirSegment("tests"):
		return CategoryTests
	case strings.HasPrefix(lower, ".github/") ||
		hasDirSegment("terraform") ||
		hasDirSegment("k8s") ||
		hasDirSegment("kubernetes") ||
		hasDirSegment("helm") ||
		hasDirSegment("infra") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tf"):
		return CategoryInfra
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".md") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".rst") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".txt"):
		return CategoryDocs
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".sql") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".csv") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".parquet") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".jsonl"):
		return CategoryData
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".json") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".yaml") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".yml") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".toml") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".ini") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".env") ||
		strings.Contains(filepath.Base(lower), "dockerfile"):
		return CategoryConfig
	}

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
understand: layered overview UI matching Understand-Anything

The previous dashboard rendered raw nodes as point dots; this rewrite
matches the Understand-Anything visual surface (per user feedback): a
layered card view as the default, dark theme, project-tour sidebar with
numbered steps, layer-category chips at the top, hand-rolled minimap,
zoom controls. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS only; no React/Vite/Node toolchain
in the repo.

Server (cmd/entire/cli/understand/dashboard/layers.go):
- Layer is the new card primitive: id, title, path, category, summary
  description, file count, symbol count, complexity (simple/moderate/
  complex), languages, checkpoint hit count, "hot" flag, embedded list
  of file_node_ids.
- LayerView (returned by /api/layers) bundles layers + count-weighted
  cross-layer edges derived from shared touched_in checkpoints.
- computeLayers is pure: groups files by top-level dir (`.github`/
  hidden dirs get their own bucket; root files cluster into "Project
  Root"). Title humanization, category heuristic (CODE/CONFIG/DOCS/
  INFRA/DATA/TESTS), complexity bands, and language tally are all
  deterministic — no semantic synthesis required.
- categorizeFile uses path-segment matching (k8s/, terraform/,
  helm/, .github/, infra/, etc.) plus extension fallbacks so the
  category chips colour layers correctly even without a trailing
  slash on the prefix.
- /api/layers handler is gated by requireToken like every other API.

UI shell (assets/index.html + app.css + app.js):
- Dark theme via :root tokens. Topbar with brand dot, view-mode
  segment (Overview / Learn / Deep Dive), Domain/Structural toggle,
  Diff OFF, category chips, layer count + semantic pill, then
  Filter/Export/Path/Theme/Help action buttons.
- Search bar full-width with Fuzzy/Semantic toggle (Semantic
  disabled with tooltip until synthesis runs).
- Card nodes: large rounded rectangles 240×130 with multi-line label
  (LAYER · complexity / title / description / file count). Cards have
  a category-coloured left border and a red border when "hot".
- Right sidebar: INFO/FILES tabs. INFO shows the project tour
  (numbered steps from top hottest layers) with Start Tour button;
  click a layer card and the panel switches to that layer's title +
  description + badges (category, complexity, hot, file count, symbol
  count) + language pills + (in FILES tab) the contained files list,
  click-to-drill-into-Deep-Dive.
- Hand-rolled minimap renders a downsampled cytoscape view + the
  current viewport rectangle into a canvas pinned bottom-right. Pans
  and zooms keep it in sync via cy.on("pan zoom").
- Zoom controls bottom-left, lock toggle freezes pan/zoom.
- View-mode switch rerenders cytoscape with either layer cards
  (Overview/Learn) or the full raw graph (Deep Dive).
- #area=<id> deep-link from `tour --dashboard` automatically jumps
  into Deep Dive and focuses the node.
- Export button generates a PNG via cy.png() and triggers a download.
- Domain/Path/Theme/Help buttons currently surface friendly banners
  pointing at the synthesis follow-up. Layout is in place; semantic
  pieces light up when synthesis runs.

Tests:
- TestComputeLayers_GroupsByTopLevelDir: cmd/, docs/, .github/,
  README.md → 4 distinct layers with correct categories.
- TestComputeLayers_ComplexityBands: 5 / 20 / 80 file tiers map to
  simple / moderate / complex.
- TestComputeLayers_CrossLayerEdgesFromSharedCheckpoints: a single
  cp touching files in two layers produces one cross-layer edge with
  weight 1.
- TestServer_LayersEndpoint: /api/layers returns LayerView JSON.
- TestServer_LayersEndpointRequiresToken: 401 without bearer.
- TestCategorizeFile: Go/Markdown/YAML/SQL/Dockerfile/test files
  hit the right buckets including k8s/ and terraform/ prefix-only
  paths.

End-to-end smoke against this repo: 17,830 nodes / 30,110 edges
collapse to 27 layers (E2e, Cmd, Docs, .claude, Project Root, …).
The UI now actually looks like the Understand-Anything screenshot
the user shared.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
